issues.description: The solution declares toString() with return type Object (public Object toString()) which does not match the expected toString() signature returning String described in the problem statement. With @Override present this causes a compile error (method does not correctly override Object.toString()) and contradicts the exercise expectation that toString() returns a String describing the lecture. Students copying or comparing to the solution could be confused or blocked by the non-compiling signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the toString method in the solution to return String with the correct signature: public String toString() { ... } so it properly overrides Object.toString() and matches the problem description/example. Ensure the @Override annotation remains and the method returns a String.
